description: Create a secret upload link to send a client so they can drop creative files (images, video) for pretesting. Returns the url and expiry; treat the url as a secret and share it only with the client. Needs a workspace admin or manager, and the feature must be enabled for the workspace (otherwise a clear 'not enabled' message).

expires_in_days.description: Days until the link expires (1-30, default 14).

label.description: Who or what the link is for, e.g. 'Acme spring banners'.

max_total_mb.description: Max total size in MB (default and cap 2048).

name: aetherya_create_intake_link
title: Create a client file-intake link
